author: Harsh Arora
text: Didn't know cookies made with zero maida and palm oil could taste this good. Great products.

author: Sakshi Verma
text: No compromises on health. Clean, homemade cookies.

author: Mahesh Gupta
text: Got my best healthy biscuit ever. Best was cardamom flavour. It’s not a kind of snack, it’s a meal. Eat 3-4 biscuits and you are done.

author: Zen Mohanty
text: Absolutely loved these cookies! The packaging feels premium and thoughtfully designed, which makes a great first impression. The quantity is generous and definitely feels worth the price. The texture is soft and satisfying, with a lovely hint of jaggery that adds a nice touch. Overall, it’s clear that a lot of care has gone into the product. Wishing the brand continued success. Highly recommend trying them! 🍪✨

author: Harshita Mishra
text: I tried bajra cookies and taste was awesome, the aroma of cardamom and homely feel in biscuits was worth appreciating..😍 …

author: Sounik Ghosh
text: These cookies are absolutely delicious and perfectly baked. They are soft, Every  bite tastes fresh and amazing! 🍪👌😋😋.

author: Nancy Priya
text: Wow, just wow!These millet cookies are a revelation - wholesome ingredients, perfectly balanced sweetness, and a delightful crunch. Guilt-free snacking just got a whole lot tastier.Paired it with a warm glass of almond milk or tea and it was a pure bliss 🍪 Once you open the jar you just can’t stop eating.

author: Harshit Kumar
text: Its one of the best healthy snacks I have eaten. Its very crunchy and tasty.

author: Kunwar Saab
text: I ordered fresh, homemade millet cookies from anwesha ji ( owner of milastry ) , and they were real game changers. Everybody in my family loved them. If you like having something sweet while also taking care of your health in a positive way, these are for you. Please order from them without giving it a second thought. 10/10 ✨

author: Souvik Chakraborty
text: I absolutely love the taste of these millet cookies. They’re healthy, not overly sweet, and perfect with tea. Will definitely buy again!

author: Lokesh Gujral
text: I tried all 3 types of cookies that they make. Personal favourite are cardamom bajra and coconut jowar. I have reordered it multiple times. Taste is amazing. Goes very well with evening coffee.

author: Pratyusha Ghosh
text: Loved the cookies! I ordered the coconut jowar, cardamom bajra, and choco ragi cookies, and every single one was delicious. Knowing they’re made without maida or palm oil made the experience even better - truly guilt-free munching.

author: Ketan Pandey
text: The cookies they offer are really healthy and in budget. Must try!

author: Sumana Roy
text: The cookies taste really amazing. They’re not just delicious, they’re healthy too. So go for it as these are totally worth it.
